_meta.rationale: Aeon's display face PP Right Grotesk Wide maps to Plus Jakarta Sans in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY. The alphabet template's primary display element is h1.a-display-1 (DRL ALPHABET_BODY line 91); .a-row carries the body specimen. The :root override from build_root_font_face_override sets --ds-font-display to the free-alternative family, so getComputedStyle(h1.a-display-1).fontFamily must contain 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Negative assertion scans the rendered HTML for the forbidden image substrings declared for slug=aeon (no aeon.co/logo, aeon-logo, aeon-wordmark).
gaps: No source-of-truth file pins a per-brand --ds-accent hex for aeon; computed_css color assertion deferred to avoid fabrication.
No spacing or section-padding value is declared per-brand for alphabet; spacing assertion deferred.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('h1.a-display-1'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('plus jakarta sans'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['aeon.co/logo', 'aeon-logo', 'aeon-wordmark', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-body'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('plus jakarta sans'); })()
